entities.name: PMID:25095771
observations: Behavioral localization experiment: with observers upright, remembered target location drifted downward over 0–1400 ms; during left-side lying, this time-dependent trajectory did not emerge and idiotropic dominance was observed.

entities.name: PMID:27595305
observations: Centrifuge experiment: gravito-inertial force increased up to 1.4G orthogonal to the idiotropic vector disrupted the time course of representational gravity but did not change its direction.
